
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- no_ble_include.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNHANDLED FAILURE -- no_ble_include.volt:4[/yellow bold]

`wifi.connect` can fail, and nothing here says what happens then: the program carries on without a connection.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] setup {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     wifi.connect("ssid", "pass")
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Add a fallback: `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.[/cyan]
